say:8:1321801108:1.text: Miss Lydia selected the <style="highlight">most serene riverside locale within the Petalia Plains</style> for the funeral. She spoke of Princess Yolena's cherished memories of the place.
say:8:1321801108:1.source_cn: 莉娅女士将葬礼地点选在了<style=highligh...

say:9:1321801109:1.text: She hoped that the sapphirine blossoms, blooming in that serene place, would accompany the princess on her final journey.
say:9:1321801109:1.source_cn: 她希望那里盛开的蓝绒花，可以陪伴公主走完最后一程。

say:12:1321801110:1.text: "Where blossoms sway and winds do croon, her life's sweet praise is ever strewn."
say:12:1321801110:1.source_cn: “繁花摇曳之地，微风轻颂着她的一生……”

say:13:1321801111:1.text: "Like snowflakes born in frost's embrace, her warmth doth call the spring's soft grace."
say:13:1321801111:1.source_cn: “如同雪花，降生在冰雪的国度；她的热烈迎来了春天……”

say:14:1321801112:1.text: "In dreams of azure, soft and deep, the river bears her, pure and meek."
say:14:1321801112:1.source_cn: “在蓝绒花编织的梦里，融化的河水托着她。”

say:15:1321801113:1.text: "In a land where pain and ill are gone, she views the sea, her heart's long song."
say:15:1321801113:1.source_cn: “在没有病痛的国度里，她远眺着向往的海……”

say:16:1321801114:1.text: "Beneath the goddess' tender gaze, her loved ones' love shall find its place."
say:16:1321801114:1.source_cn: “在女神的怀抱中，她会得到至亲的疼爱，怜悯的亲吻。”

say:17:1321801115:1.text: "With kisses kind and hearts so true, eternal love shall shine on you."

say:18:1321801116:1.text: I can do no more for Yolena, so let this poem accompany her to her final resting place.
say:18:1321801116:1.source_cn: 我无法再为亚莲娜做更多，就让这首诗伴她长眠吧。

say:21:1321801117:1.text: ... Will you not present it to Her Highness at her funeral?
say:21:1321801117:1.source_cn: ……您不在葬礼上亲自献给公主殿下吗？

say:24:1321801118:1.text: The final farewell falls upon all your shoulders.

say:25:1321801119:1.text: I cannot bring myself to say farewell to another member of the Valesa bloodline. Even for a Graveborn, it is a cruelty too heavy to bear.
say:25:1321801119:1.source_cn: 我不想再一次送别瓦勒沙家族的血脉。即便是对亡灵来说，那...

say:26:1321801120:1.text: ... Thank you for everything you've done for Her Highness and the Valesa family, Lord Ludovic.
say:26:1321801120:1.source_cn: ……感谢您为公主殿下、为瓦勒沙家族所做的一切，柳博米尔大人。

say:27:1321801121:1.text: It's time for you to send her off.

say:29:1321801106:1.text: The funeral ceremony is over. Now, we go to the river to bid our final farewells to Princess Yolena.
say:29:1321801106:1.source_cn: 安魂仪式已经结束，该去河边送别公主殿下了。
